notes: CardDemo's card detail screen (CCDL, COCRDSLC) on GENERATED data and a GENERATED map input (#4506): 30 CARDDATA records built from CVACT02Y's layout, and 30 scenarios whose RECEIVE MAP input is typed from COCRDSL's BMS source (the account and card filters: their lengths, full width / short / random, a tenth not a number, three in ten left empty; a fifth of the typed card numbers and account ids are not on file); the key pressed turns through ENTER, PF3 and keys the screen does not assign. Proves the carddemo-cardview port on inputs it was not written against; the hand-written scenarios are the ones mutation survivors point at. scenarios.name: pf3-xctl-fails-abend-routine
scenarios.why: #4316 unproven ports: reaches onAbendL250 (HANDLE ABEND LABEL(ABEND-ROUTINE), app/cbl/COCRDSLC.cbl:250). PGMIDERR RESP2 3, the program could not be loaded (IBM CICS TS, XCTL conditions): the XCTL back to the caller fails with no RESP, so CICS abends the task and the active HANDLE ABEND passes control to ABEND-ROUTINE

scenarios.name: full-commarea-length
scenarios.why: #5401 (EIBCALEN, mutation survivors): the caller states EIBCALEN as the whole COMMAREA. No shorter length can be stated: the program moves DFHCOMMAREA past 160 bytes unconditionally, a reference past EIBCALEN the oracle refuses (X23)
